name: Scenes
author: saidness
description: Save your desktop as a scene (every window, workspace, terminal directory and running TUI) and bring it all back with one key. Remembers the session before your last login too.

barWidget.description: Shows the active scene and opens the Scenes picker. Left click opens it, right click saves the current layout.

schema.label: Show scene name
schema.description: Show the name of the last saved or restored scene next to the icon.
